title.zh: 【韩国金融情报院限制 MEXC 等 27 家未申报加密交易所网站访问】
title.en: 【韩国金融情报院限制 MEXC 等 27 家未申报加密交易所网站访问】

current_state.zh: South Korea's Financial Intelligence Unit has expanded its crackdown on unregistered crypto exchanges by blocking website access to 27 platforms including MEXC and KuCoin, in addition to existing app-store restrictions, while barring registered VASPs from transferring virtual assets to undeclared entities.
current_state.en: South Korea's Financial Intelligence Unit has expanded its crackdown on unregistered crypto exchanges by blocking website access to 27 platforms including MEXC and KuCoin, in addition to existing app-store restrictions, while barring registered VASPs from transferring virtual assets to undeclared entities.
